ModelArk offers new users a free inference trial quota, allowing them to get started at no cost. Simply register BytePlus to get a certain amount of free calls to the model inference service.

<span id="54eb3225"></span>
## Usage limitations


* Free quota only applies to offsetting **online inference fees generated by pay\-as\-you\-go based on tokens** and cannot offset fees incurred from using various plugins, knowledge bases, etc.

* Free quota cannot offset tokens generated by [Batch inference (via console)](https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/docs/ModelArk/1305505) calls.

* Free quota can offset tokens hit by context cache, tokens not hit by cache, and tokens generated by output, but cannot offset storage fees incurred by caching context.

>    * For an introduction to context cache, see [Context cache](https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/docs/ModelArk/1398933).

>    * For details on context cache billing, see [Pricing](https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/docs/ModelArk/1544106).

* Free inference quota is calculated separately for different models and shared under the primary account.

   Example:

   If the main account has two sub\-accounts A and B calling the model inference service, with sub\-account A using model 1 and model 2 with inference quotas (k token) of 300 and 100 respectively, and sub\-account B using 300 and 200 respectively, then the calculations are as follows. The free inference quotas for model 1 and model 2 are both 500. Then the remaining free quota under the main account is:

   ```Plaintext
   Model1: 500 - 300 - 300 = -100 (k token)
   Model2: 500 - 100 - 200 =  200 (k token)
   ```
   

   Remaining model quota is as follows:

   Model 1: 0, and 100k token usage is generated.

   Model 2: 200k token.

* Free inference quotas are shared between base models and fine\-tuned models.

   Example:

   Assume the free inference quota for model 1 is 500; then model 1 and models fine\-tuned based on model 1 share the 500 quota.


<span id="8b905b46"></span>
## Obtain qualification

[Register and authenticate](https://console.byteplus.com/auth/signup) as a BytePlus user.

<span id="3fda7eda"></span>
## Check the quota

You can query the free quotas of various models through the following channels.


* [Model list](https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/docs/ModelArk/1330310): There is no need to log in to query the free quotas of various models.

* [Model Activation](https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/docs/ModelArk/1159200): Log in to the main account to query the deduction of the free quota under the account in real time on the console.

    &nbsp;


<span id="consumed-quota"></span>
## Consumed quota

The free quota has been exhausted, and the call will fail. To continue using it, you need to manually activate the corresponding model inference service. For the activation method, please refer to [Model Activation](https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/docs/ModelArk/1159200).

<span id="71a90a45"></span>
## Free Tokens Only mode

The Free Tokens Only Mode is the experience mode provided by the ModelArk platform for you, which can ensure that you experience the model inference service for free without incurring fees. In the Free Tokens Only Mode, when you call the inference API, you only consume the 500k token free quota presented by the platform. After approaching the free quota, the service will be suspended to avoid additional fees. For details, please refer to [Free Tokens Only mode](https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/docs/ModelArk/1465347).
